invariants: Missing data is never scored as zero (excluded from numerator and denominator).
A hard constraint is a gate, not a weighted factor.
A route requirement cannot pass without route evidence (unavailable != pass).
Rent/floor-area/availability/zoning/ownership are unverifiable at screening; disclosed, never claimed passed.
Exact property availability is never claimed; H3 centroids are zones, not premises.
Provider failure differs from observed zero.
An unavailable required factor withholds ranking.
LLM narrative cannot change deterministic ranks.
Competition can be target-band (less but not zero), not only monotonic.
No raw exception reaches the user (three-state result contract).
Reweight-promoted zones do not inherit verification evidence.
Same normalized brief resolves to a stable methodology (reproducibility).
mvpEssentialCapabilities: Conversational LLM planning that emits a validated methodology spec
log-percentile normalization + weighted composite with present-weight exclusion
Three-state result contract + graceful provider degradation
